facts.text: Mick's catch, while Rico's men stumble round.
facts.why: In the Australian half Walter leads Rico's men on a false trail while Mick picks them off one by one and holds them in a cave. Nothing shows Mick catching yabbies or fishing in the bush.
facts.fix: Bush tucker while Walter misleads Rico's men.

vibe.verdict: Good bush grub and a believable camp, but it barely touches the film's famous moments and lists the snags twice.
missing: Walter's faked death by crocodile (the cave)
Mick and his mates calling in help with the bullroarer (the bush)
Leroy Brown and Rat's street gang (New York)
Mick swapping clothes with Rico (the ambush)
Blast fishing in the harbour (New York)
ideas: Cut 'Wally's snags in bread with onions', it is the same dish as 'Wally's Walkabout Creek snags'.
Swap 'Steak sandwich' (note: The Walkabout Creek pub) for 'Subway handoff hot dogs' with a note about Rico's trap at the station.
Change the 'No crocs allowed' slip to 'Walter's croc attack: faked' so the croc joke comes from the film.
Add 'Belonga Mick' to the Kakadu plum salsa note, replacing 'The Top End'.
